title: Old product photos are never removed from the picture store
what: When an owner changes a product photo, deletes a product, or a gym is deleted, the old photo file stays in the public picture store for good. Only the product's link to it changes. Every replaced or abandoned photo keeps using the free 1 GB picture store and download traffic.
expected: A replaced or deleted product photo, and the photos of a deleted gym, are removed from the picture store (at once or by a nightly clean-up).
who: MettleUp (cost), every gym sharing the store
how_often: every photo change or product delete
fix_line: Delete the old file when a photo is replaced or a product or gym goes, and clean up files no product points at every night

title: Anyone can start demo gyms and upload photos with no total limit
what: Starting a demo gym needs no sign-in and gives an owner key; up to 300 new gyms an hour are allowed across the whole project, each with a ready-made shop. Each gym can hold 50 upload tickets at once, and one ticket lets in any number of 3 MB photos for 15 minutes. Nothing limits how much one gym stores in total, and demo gyms are never cleared unless their name starts with 'QA '. One person could fill the shared free database and picture store for every real gym.
expected: A cap on photos and space per gym, a one-file-per-ticket rule, a tighter limit on demo gyms per visitor, and unused demo gyms cleared after some days.
fix_line: Limit files per ticket and space per gym, slow down demo starts per visitor, and clear old untouched demo gyms nightly
